result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the bottom navigation has a clear layout defect where a thick black bar overlaps and obscures tab icons.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar in the bottom navigation overlaps the search and orders/bookmark icons, partially obscuring them instead of sitting below the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the bar (home indicator) beneath the tab icons and add bottom safe-area padding so it no longer collides with the navigation icons.
